question.en: The correct expression of $8.\overline{46}$ in the fractional form is ______.
question.hi: भिन्नात्मक रूप में $8.\overline{46}$ का सही व्यंजक ______ है।

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option A (**838/99**).
solution.keyConcept: Mixed Whole + Bar: N.(ab)̅ = (Nab − N) / 99 = N + ab/99

trapAlert.en: Option C (`846/99`) is a classic trap (`> 8.54`, NOT `8.46̅`!). Never forget to subtract integer `8` (`846 − 8 = 838`)!

title.hi: विधि 2: कुल से बिना-बार घटाएं (`3 सेकंड`)

solution.en:
Method 1: Split Whole + Fraction ($8 + \frac{46}{99}$): $8.\overline{46} = 8 + 0.\overline{46} = 8 + \frac{46}{99} = \frac{8 \times 99 + 46}{99} = \frac{792 + 46}{99} = \mathbf{\frac{838}{99}}$.

Method 2: Full Subtract Formula (`3 sec`): $\frac{\text{All digits} - \text{Non-bar part}}{99} = \frac{846 - 8}{99} = \mathbf{\frac{838}{99}}$!
